time_mapping.ordering: look 1 late, look 2 central, look 3 early

cross_spectrum_domain_choice.chosen_domain: intensity images derived from the preserved complex sub-looks
cross_spectrum_domain_choice.primary_source: Li, Mouche, Stopa & Chapron (2019), JGR Oceans, doi:10.1029/2018JC014638, section 2.2.1
cross_spectrum_domain_choice.source_method_summary: The SLC azimuth spectrum is divided into three non-overlapping parts, inverse transformed into sub-look intensity images, and 2-D image cross-spectra are then formed.

roi.description: Open water immediately seaward of the central rocky coast; refined on full-aperture SICD intensity to exclude the terrain displaced by constant-HAE projection.

peak_search.conjugate_pair_treatment: centro-symmetric power average; one half-plane retained

three_look_peak_stability.orientation_semantics: The 2-D FFT peak gives the modulation wavevector; visible crest/stripe orientation is perpendicular (+90 degrees, modulo 180).

cross_spectra.input_domain: detrended and spatially windowed sub-look intensity

roi.description: Open water farther seaward; refined on full-aperture SICD intensity to exclude all coastline pixels.

peak_search.conjugate_pair_treatment: centro-symmetric power average; one half-plane retained

three_look_peak_stability.orientation_semantics: The 2-D FFT peak gives the modulation wavevector; visible crest/stripe orientation is perpendicular (+90 degrees, modulo 180).

cross_spectra.input_domain: detrended and spatially windowed sub-look intensity

roi.description: Persistent terrestrial infrastructure, roads, and surrounding terrain near the central facility.

peak_search.conjugate_pair_treatment: centro-symmetric power average; one half-plane retained

three_look_peak_stability.reason: Best triplet did not pass all wavelength/orientation/prominence thresholds.
three_look_peak_stability.orientation_semantics: The 2-D FFT peak gives the modulation wavevector; visible crest/stripe orientation is perpendicular (+90 degrees, modulo 180).

land_control_deterministic_terms.domain: log1p of 8-column block-averaged land intensity; approximately isotropic ground pixels
land_control_deterministic_terms.complex_sublook_note: The three complex sub-looks occupy disjoint Doppler bands, so land registration and deterministic phase-ramp checks are performed on their intensity images. Log compression prevents a few extreme point scatterers from dominating phase correlation; raw-intensity results are retained as diagnostics.
